name: Google data centre & cloud region, Elmina
status_detail: Construction · reported 30 May 2024 (announcement); ground broken October 2024
summary: Google's first data centre in Malaysia, together with a Google Cloud region, at Sime Darby Property's Elmina Business Park in Greater Kuala Lumpur. Announced as part of a US$2 billion investment.

scale.label: Scope
scale.value: First Google data centre in Malaysia + Google Cloud region + AI literacy programs

why_it_matters: The anchor project of the Klang Valley's AI-infrastructure wave. A hyperscale campus in Shah Alam, not Johor, signals Selangor's push to keep data centre investment inside Greater KL despite land and power constraints.
questions_to_follow: Does the campus reach operational status on the announced timeline?
Does the cloud region go live in the same phase as the data centre?
Do follow-on expansions land at Elmina or spill to Banting, Sepang, Sungai Buloh or Puchong?
location_precision: Elmina Business Park, Shah Alam (Guthrie Corridor). Coordinates are area-level; exact building footprint unverified.

sources.title: Advancing Malaysia Together: Google Announces US$2 Billion Investment in Malaysia, Including First Google Data Center and Google Cloud Region
Google's Hyperscale Data Centre at Elmina Business Park Breaks Ground
Google Breaks Ground on US$2 Billion Malaysia Data Center and Cloud Region

history.event: US$2 billion investment announced; Elmina Business Park named as the site.
Groundbreaking ceremony officiated by the Prime Minister; Sime Darby Property is Malaysia's first developer to execute a built-to-suit lease for a data centre.
